reviews.review_msg: Dr. Bird is awesome. He really cares about how you do in his class, he gives good feedback on the assignments. Overall really chill guy would def recommend taking a course with him.
Flexible with assignment topics and methods. Be prepared for short in-class reflections about readings but don't stress out about them too much. Very kind and approachable if you need help.

Super nice professor. Gave great feedback and had interesting course content/readings. Just make sure you do the readings since there's lots of discussion/sharing thoughts (participation is recorded, but you won't be cold called) and also for the weekly in class reflections. Would definitely recommend!

No complaints about how Lauren dealt with the course material; all the readings were given their time and she clearly had a good grasp on how to navigate as difficult a subject as genocide through history. Group projects will always be a fine experience or a terrible one depending on your fellow classmates, so just be aware that it's gonna happen.

Amazing professor! Her lectures are clearly organized and easy to understand and follow. She cares deeply about her students and mental health, and even brought snacks for us for lectures. She is kind, very informative, and accessible for extra help. Highly recommend taking class with this professor.

I took her class on Genocide in a Historical Context and she was phenomenal. Her grading was fair, and she was so amazing. She would bring us snacks in order to make the stuff we were talking about a bit easier. She cares so much about her students mental health, especially on such a heavy topic. Will be taking her again!
She is a great professor who is always available for extra help. I would highly recommend taking a class with her, however, you will have to work hard!

Great professor, chill classes and good tutorials, the first half of the lecture is usually a little bit slow but the he really gets into the content in the second half, he explained complex topics in a way that was easily digestible. Fair grader, interesting and meaningful projects, would take again.

Dr. May is a great professor, and does a fantastic job at teaching his lectures. The course included at Mid-Term, a final project, and some small assignments. Overall, the course was pretty good, and I would most certainly take a course again with, Dr. May
